title: PBA: Magnolia punches quarterfinals ticket with rout of Ginebra
summary: The Magnolia Hotshots pulled away for a 112-93 victory over archrival Barangay Ginebra to secure their place in the quarterfinals of the 2026 PBA Governors' Cup on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum.
